title: Fake KYC update / account block
summary: Fraudsters pose as your bank and claim your KYC has expired or your account will be blocked, pushing you to a fake link or app to steal login details.
keywords: kyc update pan verify account blocked suspended deactivated freeze bank netbanking yono khata band
red_flags: Link or app outside the official bank site
what_to_do: Do not click the link or install any app
Check KYC status only in the bank's official app or at a branch
Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930

title: Fake reward points / cashback
summary: Messages claim your credit card reward points are about to expire and ask you to install an app or open a link to redeem them. The app steals card and banking data.
keywords: reward points redeem cashback expire expiring card claim credit points
red_flags: Unknown app or link to redeem
what_to_do: Redeem rewards only inside your bank's official app
Never install an APK sent through SMS
Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930

title: Electricity bill disconnection scam
summary: A message says your power will be cut tonight because of an unpaid bill and tells you to call an 'officer' or pay through a link. Real utilities do not threaten same-day disconnection from a personal mobile number.
keywords: electricity bill disconnected power supply cut officer connection tonight bijli kat msedcl adani
what_to_do: Do not call the number or pay via the link
Check dues on the utility's official website or app
Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930

title: Courier / parcel / customs scam
summary: You are told a parcel is held because of a wrong address or customs charges and asked to pay a small fee on a fake page or send money to release it.
keywords: parcel package courier delivery held customs clearance redelivery address india post bluedart
red_flags: Small fee on an unofficial link
what_to_do: Track parcels only on the courier's official website or app
Never pay customs or redelivery fees through a link in an SMS
Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930

title: Fake job / work-from-home scam
summary: Offers of high daily pay for easy tasks such as liking videos or data entry. Victims are asked for a registration fee or deposit, then lose the money or get pulled into task scams.
keywords: job work from home earn daily salary registration fee deposit part time telegram whatsapp kamayein ghar baithe hiring
red_flags: Very high pay for easy work
Contact only through Telegram or WhatsApp
what_to_do: Genuine employers never charge a fee to hire you
Verify the company on its official website
Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930

title: Instant loan / advance-fee scam
summary: A pre-approved loan with no documents appears, but you must first pay a processing or insurance fee. Some loan apps also steal contacts and photos and use them for harassment.
keywords: loan approved sanctioned instant processing fee insurance charge disbursal pre-approved no documents app
red_flags: App asking for contacts and photos
what_to_do: Borrow only from RBI-registered lenders
Never pay a fee to receive a loan
Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930

title: Credit card limit / block scam
summary: Scammers claim your card limit was raised or the card is blocked and ask for card number, CVV or OTP 'to verify'. With these details they make payments from your card.
keywords: credit card limit increased blocked suspicious activity cvv otp card number unblock verify activate
red_flags: Card blocked / limit increased out of nowhere
what_to_do: Never share OTP, CVV or PIN with anyone
Call the number printed on the back of your card
Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930

title: Income tax refund scam
summary: Fake messages from the 'Income Tax Department' promise a refund and ask for bank details on a look-alike website.
keywords: income tax refund itr pending bank details eligible pan account number department
red_flags: Bank details requested through a link
what_to_do: Check refund status only on the official income tax portal
The department does not ask for bank passwords or OTP by SMS
Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930

title: Lottery / lucky draw / prize scam
summary: You are told you won a lottery, KBC draw or a free phone. To claim it you must pay a delivery fee, tax or call a 'manager'. The prize does not exist.
keywords: lottery won winner prize lucky draw kbc iphone giveaway claim congratulations inaam jeeta selected
red_flags: Prize for a contest you never entered
Celebrity or brand name used for trust
what_to_do: Ignore it - you cannot win a contest you did not enter
Never pay money to receive a prize
Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930

title: Aadhaar update / deactivation scam
summary: Messages say your Aadhaar will be deactivated unless you link or update it now, and ask for your Aadhaar number and OTP.
keywords: aadhaar uidai deactivated link update mandatory otp penalty verification number
what_to_do: Use only the official UIDAI website or app
Never share Aadhaar OTP over SMS or phone
Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930

title: SIM block / TRAI impersonation scam
summary: Callers or messages impersonating TRAI or police say your SIM will be blocked for illegal activity and push you to talk to an 'officer', often leading to digital-arrest style extortion.
keywords: sim blocked trai disconnected mobile number verification officer illegal activity police press 9 band
what_to_do: Hang up - agencies do not threaten you over SMS or phone calls
Check your SIM status with your telecom operator directly
Report on the Sanchar Saathi portal, at cybercrime.gov.in, or call 1930

title: UPI refund / collect-request scam
summary: A fraudster says money was sent to you by mistake or that you earned cashback, then sends a collect request or QR code. Approving it or entering your UPI PIN sends money out of your account.
keywords: upi refund collect request pin qr scan cashback mistake phonepe paytm google pay approve received wapas
red_flags: Collect request or QR code to 'receive' money
what_to_do: You never need your UPI PIN to receive money
Decline unknown collect requests
Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930

title: General safe-SMS habits
summary: Common signs of smishing: urgency, threats, requests for OTP or PIN, unknown links or shortened URLs, and unexpected money.
keywords: urgent link otp pin click sms suspicious unknown sender
red_flags: Requests for OTP, PIN or CVV
what_to_do: Do not click links or call numbers in the message
Contact the organisation through its official app or website
Forward spam to 1909 and report fraud at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930
